values.condition: Heliocentric radial velocity reported for US 708 (taken from Hirsch et al. 2005)

evidence.quote: US 708 is an extremely He-rich sdO star in the Galaxy halo, with a heliocentric radial velocity of +708 ± 15 km/s (Hirsch et al. 2005).

notes: US 708: the paper treats it as a known hypervelocity star and discusses the WD + He star channel as a possible surviving-companion origin, without making a new determination of its Galactic bound status (T:p3-b8).

US 708: Only the heliocentric radial velocity is reported for US 708; no position, distance, parallax, proper motion, or galactocentric quantities for this star are given. The spatial velocity distribution (Fig. 4; >400 km/s) pertains to the model population of surviving companions, not to US 708 individually, so it is not recorded.
